mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% over three months signals an improving labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% in three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% in three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 2% over three months signals a weakening supply chain, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 2% in three months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a low federal funds rate (below 1%) signals accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where FEDFUNDS was below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% each over three months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 0.5% and UNRATE decrease > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both PAYEMS increased and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% in three months.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional mechanism where a decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% during a recession signals a contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 1% during a recession.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 1% each over six months signals a positive supply shock, which reduces costs and boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increase > 1% and CPIAUCSL decrease > 1% in 6 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both INDPRO increased and CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 1% in six months.
